items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: And he played most with this man, played Clannett, what's his name, Dyer, when he was going to California?

ctx.x: Did you know Hilaire Andrew? Sure, I knew Hilaire. He was a nice drummer. Where was he from? Here. And who did he play with in Lionhead? Did you know him back then? Well, Hilaire, I believe he played some too with this Jelly Roll.
And he played most with this man, played Clannett, what's his name, Dyer, when he was going to California? Jimmy Noon.
